reviews.text: Switched to this mobile groomer after overpaying and was pleasantly surprised. The groomer was personable, good with my dog, and did a fantastic job (as you can see by his handsome photo) 🤗 highly recommend! …

My Picasso had a great experience with Furry Land grooming services.
Excellent groomer,I will definitely call them again.
Thank you 😊

I chose this company because my dog is anxious with groomers and does best when he sees the same person every 6–7 weeks.

Unfortunately, three consecutive appointments with that groomer were canceled or changed by the company. Each time, the solution offered was simply to use a different groomer instead of rescheduling with the same one. I gave that a try once, and the quality of the groom was significantly worse.

I completely understand that people get sick, have emergencies, or take time off. My disappointment is that the company repeatedly failed to provide the continuity they knew was essential for my dog, despite several conversations about it.

If consistency with a particular groomer matters to you, this is something you should be aware of before booking.

I have been searching for a place to get my dog groomed and this one showed up. I took my chance and I'm glad I did I don't know the name of the woman who came to cut my dog's hair. But she did amazing and I hope I can book with her again. So thank you! Thank you so much for making this a wonderful experience for me and for cookie and I can't wait to book with you guys again soon!

The experience was lovely! They came straight to my house not long after the planned time and the person doing my dog (Jenia) was very nice and amazing! She made him look amazing and smell amazing! Will be using again and highly recommend, the price is very good for the services!

Rochelle did amazing work with my miniature schnauzer and honestly gave him the best cut he’s ever had! She was professional and personable. I was hesitant using a new groomer since I’m new in town, but I am so glad I gave this groomer a chance. This service is super convenient, the team communicates welll and they’ll treat your fur baby with care!

Will definitely be a regular client! My cats looked so peaceful and happy afterward. They were clean, relaxed, and had definitely worked up an appetite by the time we got back inside. Very good service and a great experience overall!
Great customer service my Tank loves his groomer. She is so kind and professional.
Wonderful experience! Rochelle was wonderful and took the best care of our pup. He smells and looks amazing. Highly recommend!

All of the groomers that come to my place to groom my dogs are wonderful, very kind and really care about doing a great job for the dogs. Highly recommend them to anyone with dogs.  Brittni was awesome today.

Megan Tobar is the absolute best. My dog is extremely timid and shy. She LOVES Megan. Not only is the grooming perfect every time, but knowing that my pup is with someone who will be patient and gentle with her is amazing. Would refer Megan over and over again! Before & After pics below.
Great service! We had our 10yr old German shepherd groomed, they were so good with her and she looked amazing afterwards! Definitely will be booking again.

Janayi did a great job!

Omg I finally found a groomer that services cats! Not only do they take cats but they are knowledgeable, thorough and so caring. I've been searching for cat groomers since I adopted my large, overweight cat who can't fully clean himself well, but all other grooming places wouldn't take a cat at all or one that hasn't been professionally groomed before. After months of searching, I finally stumbled across Furry Land's website and booked an appointment to get my cat bathed, and his eyes, ears, nails and potty area cleaned. They texted me when they were on their way, arrived early and we're kind enough to park super close to my apartment. I let my groomer Sally know that I had previously shaved down my cat Hummus' hair mats and and I helped hold him down while she shaved down the matting in his potty area (too difficult for a non-professional like me to handle at home!). I left Hummus in her care and like 25 minutes later he was bathed, trimmed and clean! The whole process was easy, comfortable and quick for both me and my cat and I couldn't be happier with the results. Sally was a lovely groomer who was gentle with my cat and very communicative and kind to me as well. We will be booking with and recommending Furry Land as well as Sally from now on.

This was my first time taking Max to the groomer and it was an amazing experience down to the booking! Ellie booked the appt for us and she was so kind, compassionate, and informative. Jenia was so loving with Max and made us feel comfortable, not mention he looks so handsome! Will DEFINITELY be back
Megan our groomer was great with our nervous spaniel and the cut was exceptional

My groomer, Jenia is fantastic with my sweet girl Penelope. She followed all the instructions I gave, and did a terrific job. I will definitely continue to use them.  I’m also Always able to get a fast appointment! Love this service so much!

Great service all around! Easy to book and schedule online. Groomers are very friendly. My dog gets a bit nervous and each groomer has been extremely patient and gentle!

Furry land Mobile Grooming is the most professional, buttoned-up, well-run and courteous grooming service I’ve ever used. And I’ve been through countless—both storefront and mobile groomers, each of which came well-recommended. But FurryLand, whom I’ve used for the last several years, is the crème de la crème. For one thing, their grooming pro’s are top-notch. Jania and Megan are conscientious, careful, thorough, always ask plenty of questions and have a gentleness of spirit about them that my two big dogs (male and female) respond very favorably to. Cannot recommend FurryLand enough. Gold stars all across the board!!!
Amazing job grooming my two main coons. Best haircuts they’ve ever gotten. Sally did a great job!!!
Thanks Blake! So happy you were pleased with Sally and our services. We look forward to seeing you again in the near future.
Love their service!

10/10 perfect service and fantastic groom by Jenia. The sign up process over the phone was quick and I was able to send my dog’s vaccine record via text to their office (so no online profile needed!). I was on a wait list for scheduling because my work schedule is abit crazy, and the administrator communicated with me via text for optional appointments and that was very convenient. Once we scheduled, I had another change and needed to push the appointment by 90 min, and the administrator offered to coordinate a swap with another client which worked out. The actual groomer, Jenia, texted when she was on her way, and as soon as Odin met her, he was so excited to see her and jump in the van and get started. She was super gentle with him (he’s very old!), and the groom took awhile bc he needed so much work, but Jenia didn’t cut corners and did a phenomenal job with the cut even though we had the last spot on a Friday. He’s honestly never looked this good!!!  Thank you Furry Land and esp Ms Jenia we will be calling again for the next time and beyond.
Thank you for the 5 Star Review Justin!! We look forward to seeing you again soon!
